Your account, private reports, and personal votes will be deleted. Your public charging points will be reassigned to Anonymous. Their content will not change.

If you want those public contributions removed, cancel and delete them manually before closing your account.

Local rides and Bluetooth captures stay on this device. This does not close accounts with music or leaderboard providers.

Confirmation is available for 30 days. Expired confirmation records are removed on the next deletion request. Older service backups may retain account data for up to 30 days.
